title: Common
description: Shared definitions for Skyhaul drone messages, schema_version 1. Units are in the names: _m meters, _mps meters per second, _pct percent, _deg degrees, _s seconds.

Uuid.title: Uuid
Uuid.description: Canonical lowercase UUID string, any version.

DroneId.title: DroneId
DroneId.description: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. No '.', '*' or '#', so it is always one safe routing-key word.

Timestamp.title: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp with exactly millisecond precision and a 'Z' suffix, e.g. 2026-11-23T10:00:00.123Z. Producer wall clock.

TypeName.title: TypeName
TypeName.description: Wire form of a message type: uppercase letters, digits and underscores. Whether the type is known is decided by the catalogue (MessageType), not by the envelope, so an unknown type can still be answered with a NACK.

MessageType.title: MessageType
MessageType.description: Every message type in schema_version 1: the union of CommandType and TelemetryType.

CommandType.title: CommandType
CommandType.description: Messages sent to a drone on the fleet.cmd exchange.

TelemetryType.title: TelemetryType
TelemetryType.description: Messages sent by a drone on the fleet.telemetry exchange.

NackReason.title: NackReason
NackReason.description: Why a command was rejected. INJECTED comes from a test fault, INTERNAL_ERROR from a handler that raised.

Lon.title: Lon
Lon.description: Longitude in degrees, WGS84. 180 is written as -180.

AltitudeM.title: AltitudeM
AltitudeM.description: Commanded altitude in meters above the home point (AGL).

SpeedMps.title: SpeedMps
SpeedMps.description: Commanded horizontal speed in meters per second.

HeadingDeg.title: HeadingDeg
HeadingDeg.description: Heading in degrees true, clockwise from north.
